content:
Maya: quick sync — noticed oscillation when the auto fallback flips between model-A and model-B repeatedly. clients see intermittent errors and paging noise. idea: add a per-route "pause window" (lockout) after a fallback so we avoid flip-flops. configurable duration, default short. thoughts?

Kevin: yep saw the same on friday. two questions: is this a fixed TTL or exponential backoff? do we count triggers per minute or dedupe by request id?

Tara: from the console side we should show a sticky banner + an operator action: "pause auto-fallback for X minutes" (snooze) + reason. and link to the decision trace. users need clear affordances.

Eli: implementation idea — short lockout (30s default) then escalate if it keeps oscillating. policy fields like `fallback_lockout_ms` and `lockout_decay`. emit events: `fallback.lockout_started` with cause, route, model_ids.

Maya: telemetry: sample a small fraction during lockout (1%) for full KV traces. audit logs must record auto-lockout events, operator overrides, and model switch IDs. essential for postmortems.

Kevin: also we need to define triggers that cause fallback: 5xx-rate, p95 latency, or semantic mismatch score. make triggers configurable per-route. and confirm lockout doesn't block intentional graceful-degrade modes.

Tara: wording note: avoid "hard/soft fallback" ambiguity. propose "Failover" = switch model, "Graceful degrade" = restricted feature path (cache/short response). microcopy: "Graceful degrade: reduced capability to preserve latency".

Eli: infra note — decision-service must expose lockout state, remaining TTL, and cause code in the API. also add a `simulate-lockout` in the preview sandbox so PMs can validate.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled — `fallback-lockout-v1` -> 10% traffic on 2025-11-12T10:00Z. watch metric `fallbacks_per_min` and `fallback_lockout_count`.

Kevin: QA asks for an e2e harness that replays error bursts and asserts no flip-flop within TTL. also a smoke test that verifies audit event emission for the lockout.

Maya: OK — I'll put together console mocks and a short RFC outlining policy shape, telemetry, and operator UX. will tag design and infra.

Tara: on copy. will draft tooltip + banner text and a short "why did we pause" explainer that links to decision trace and sampled request logs.

Eli: opened a tiny policy proto PR in draft: `message LockoutPolicy { int64 duration_ms = 1; double decay_rate = 2; repeated string trigger_metrics = 3; }` — will iterate.

Maya: :thumbsup: next step: design + infra + telemetry sync Fri 09:00. if no objections i'll start the RFC tomorrow.
